questions.text: Outline any concerns regarding the impact of the Acquisition on competition, including if MPMS and Grow are close competitors and there are not many alternatives or if one is a major supplier to competitors of the other.
Who do you consider to be the key suppliers of superannuation administration services in Australia and what are the differentiating factors between these suppliers?
Provide any additional information or comments that you consider relevant to the ACCC’s assessment of the Acquisition.
Provide a brief description of your business or organisation, including any commercial relationships with MPMS and/or Grow.
